description: This file contains extension methods for mapping entity objects to Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) in the TaskFlow API. Specifically, it provides methods to convert User and TaskItem entities into their respective DTO representations.

classes.name: ModelMappings
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to map entity models to DTOs.

methods.name: ToDto(User user)
methods.description: Converts a User entity to a UserDto object.

methods.name: ToDto(TaskItem task)
methods.description: Converts a TaskItem entity to a TaskDto object.
